podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Collective Album Sales of Members
podcast.body: The three members of Them Crooked Vultures—Dave Grohl, Josh Homme, and John Paul Jones—are collectively responsible for selling an estimated 150 million to 200 million albums throughout their careers. "In that semi-circle, there were people responsible for selling, what, 150 million albums, 200 million albums?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Stop Me If You've Heard This One Before

podcast.title: Interview at Pink Duck Studios, Burbank
podcast.body: The band was interviewed at Josh Homme's Pink Duck Studios in Burbank, which from the front resembled an old corner store with a blocked door, but around back offered access to a small parking area with a deck and picnic table. The interview included Josh Homme, John Paul Jones, and Dave Grohl. "One Wednesday, I got a call asking if I'd like to interview the band in Josh's studio in Burbank."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Stop Me If You've Heard This One Before

podcast.title: John Paul Jones's Tea Service
podcast.body: During an interview at Pink Duck Studios, John Paul Jones, the legendary bassist from Led Zeppelin, offered and fetched a cup of tea for an interviewer. He inquired about preference for milk or lemon and returned promptly with a cup and saucer. "Did I just send the bass player a Led Zeppelin out to fetch me a cup of tea?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Stop Me If You've Heard This One Before

podcast.title: Supergroup Formation
podcast.body: Them Crooked Vultures was formed as a supergroup, bringing together Josh Homme, Foo Fighters' Dave Grohl, and Led Zeppelin's bass player John Paul Jones. "Josh was one-third of them crooked vultures, a supergroup that featured Buddy Dave Grohl and Led Zeppelin bass player John Paul Jones."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Secrets of Queens of the Stone Age: Part 2

podcast.title: Supergroup Formation (Years Ago)
podcast.body: The band formed after years of casual discussions among Dave Grohl (Foo Fighters), Josh Homme (Queens of the Stone Age), and John Paul Jones (Led Zeppelin) about creating music together. They finally decided to make it a reality. "After years of joking about forming a band together, Dave Grohl of the Fung Fighters, Josh Hommie of Queens of the Stone Age, and Led Zeppelin's John Paul Jones decided to make it happen with them crooked vultures."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Stop Me If You've Heard This One Before

xref.title: John Paul Jones's Courtesy
xref.body: John Paul Jones, the bassist for Led Zeppelin and member of Them Crooked Vultures, demonstrated exceptional politeness during an interview at Pink Duck Studios. He offered to fetch tea and returned with it promptly, even plucking some "vaguely Zeppelin-esque notes" on a bass before doing so. "Splendid. Just ask if you need anything. Can I get you a cup of tea?"
